team_comps.name: Dive Comp
team_comps.description: Hard engage from multiple angles. Collapse on carries.
team_comps.strength: Burst + lockdown. Wins teamfights through target access.
team_comps.weakness: Loses to disengage comps (Janna, Braum, Alistar).

team_comps.name: Protect the Carry
team_comps.description: Keep one hypercarry alive while they deal all damage.
team_comps.strength: Late-game teamfight. Unstoppable if carry stays alive.
team_comps.weakness: Weak to hard engage + burst before shields go up.

team_comps.name: Poke Comp
team_comps.description: Whittle enemies before fights start. Never commit.
team_comps.strength: Wins sieges and objective dances. Safe and consistent.
team_comps.weakness: Hard engage bypasses poke. Flanks collapse the backline.

team_comps.name: Wombo Combo
team_comps.description: Stack AoE ultimates for devastating teamfight wipes.
team_comps.strength: One good ult combo wins the game. Dragon/Baron fights.
team_comps.weakness: If you miss the combo, you have nothing. Split push beats you.

team_comps.name: Pick Comp
team_comps.description: Catch isolated enemies. Win through numbers advantage.
team_comps.strength: Vision control + hooks/charms = picks. Snowballs leads.
team_comps.weakness: Falls behind if enemy groups and you can't find picks.

team_comps.name: Split Push
team_comps.description: 1-3-1 or 1-4. Force enemy to choose which threat to answer.
team_comps.strength: Constant map pressure. Takes towers and forces rotations.
team_comps.weakness: Requires coordination. Loses 5v5 if caught grouped.

team_comps.name: Drain Tank
team_comps.description: Sustain through fights. Outlast the enemy with healing.
team_comps.strength: Extended fights favor you. Hard to kill in teamfights.
team_comps.weakness: Grievous Wounds items reduce healing. Burst kills through sustain.

team_comps.name: Global Pressure
team_comps.description: Impact the whole map with global/semi-global abilities.
team_comps.strength: Turn any fight into a numbers advantage. Roaming tempo.
team_comps.weakness: Weaker in direct 5v5 if globals are down.
